contents.text:
I’m ready to help analyze your media files. To get started, please upload the files or share links to them. Also tell me what you’d like to learn from the analysis.

Possible analyses I can perform:
- Visual content
  - Identify objects, scenes, and activities
  - Detect and describe people or landmarks (without identifying individuals unless you request it)
  - OCR to extract text visible in images
  - Image quality metrics (resolution, blur, compression)
  - Scene changes and video summarization
  - Generate short captions or alt text
- Audio content
  - Transcribe speech (speech-to-text)
  - Language identification
  - Speaker and emotion cues (if you want limited, non-identifying analysis)
  - Classify ambient sounds or music
- Metadata
  - EXIF/metadata extraction (camera, location if available)
  - Video/audio duration, codecs, bitrate, frame rate
- Output format
  - Per-file reports (text or JSON)
  - A concise summary or a detailed, structured report
  - Annotated visuals (overlaid captions or bounding boxes on images/videos)

Helpful questions to tailor the results:
- What file types are you providing (images, video, audio)?
- Do you want privacy-preserving analysis (e.g., no facial recognition, only general attributes)?
- Do you prefer a human-readable summary, a structured JSON, or both?
- Should I produce per-file results and an overall summary?

If you already have a specific task in mind (e.g., “extract all text from these images” or “transcribe the audio and identify the language”), tell me and I’ll focus on that. Please upload the first file when you’re ready.
